purpose: Teach: 容積/相乗/喝采/セレクション/省エネルギー/真っ最中/ダントツ/授賞

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、容積比較を実験で確認しろ
lines.en: Ren — confirm the volume ratio experimentally.
lines.style: Direct, measured. Leans forward slightly. Authority wrapped in expectation, not harshness. Each phrase lands with quiet weight. No room for drift.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。理論と実験の相乗的な発展を目指します
lines.en: Yes. I'm aiming for synergistic development between theory and experiment.
lines.style: Careful and earnest. Slightly formal register — he's speaking to his advisor. A small hesitation before diving into the compound concept, like he's choosing his words precisely. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学界の喝采を浴びる研究を目指せ
lines.en: Ren — aim for research that draws academic acclaim.
lines.style: Clear, matter-of-fact. A statement of expectation more than suggestion. Steady tone, no inflection at the end. The kind of instruction that doesn't ask for agreement, just execution.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。被験者のセレクション基準を厳格にします
lines.en: Yes. I'll be rigorous with the subject selection criteria.
lines.style: Nods slightly on the opening word. Deliberate, thoughtful — he's already thinking through the implications. Slower pace on the technical phrase. A note of determination underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室は省エネルギーを徹底しろ
lines.en: Ren — the lab needs to be strict about energy conservation.
lines.style: Practical, not scolding. A directive stated as a fact. Calm, even tone. The kind of boss who cares about efficiency both as principle and resource.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文締切真っ最中で集中します
lines.en: Yes. We're in the middle of paper deadlines, so I'll stay focused.
lines.style: Quiet acknowledgment. A slight weariness underneath — he knows the pressure. Steady voice, no complaint. Just stating the reality and his commitment to it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、ダントツの引用数を目指せ
lines.en: Ren — aim to be top in citation count.
lines.style: Clear and ambitious. No hedging. Spoken like a challenge and a belief. Brief, sharp. The confidence of someone who knows what matters in the field.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会の授賞対象を狙います
lines.en: Yes. I'm targeting the conference award.
lines.style: Small breath at the start. Conviction in his voice now — he's moved past formality into genuine resolve. Finality in the closing. Like he's made a promise to himself and is announcing it.
